name: stream-radar
description: Stream Radar — ultra media streaming detector + WatchParty + auto Indonesian subtitles, for Chrome & Firefox (Manifest V3). Not published to any store: load it unpacked.

scripts.test: node --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 tools/test/core.test.mjs tools/test/demo.test.mjs tools/test/design.test.mjs tools/test/features.test.mjs tools/test/i18n.test.mjs tools/test/integration.test.mjs tools/test/modules.test.mjs tools/test/order.test.mjs tools/test/player.test.mjs tools/test/theme.test.mjs tools/test/publish.test.mjs tools/test/theme-cycle.test.mjs tools/test/ui.test.mjs tools/test/updater.test.mjs tools/test/userscript.test.mjs
scripts.update: node -e "require('child_process').execSync('git stash -u',{stdio:'inherit'});require('child_process').execSync('git pull origin kerjalanjut',{stdio:'inherit'});" && node tools/build.mjs
scripts.sync:dist: node tools/build.mjs && git add -f dist/chrome dist/firefox userscript/stream-radar.user.js docs/preview/ui.html && git commit -m "chore: refresh generated build snapshot"
